# Version 4.150.8 (Unreleased)
> **Raster and texture corrections**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.8 brings raster-pipeline safety and texture-sampling fixes to the m150 line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Safer region and runtime-shader processing** — Corrects region-buffer sizing for subdivided conics and checks accumulation overflow. Failed runtime-shader stage construction no longer leaves executable partial pipelines with unresolved branch offsets; transformed shader child failures propagate correctly. ([#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543), [#5633](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5633))
- **Texture uploads and subset edges** — Disables an unsupported GLES upload format for BGRA textures interpreted as RGBx. Nearest-filtered texture subsets retain clamps when magnification or fractional coordinates could otherwise sample neighboring texels, while preserving the integer-aligned fast path. ([#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543))
